tasks.title: Watcher: debounced change detection that spawns the worker

details.goal: Keep the graph current without putting the writer in the server process.
details.contract: watch.ts exports startWatch(opts: {repoRoot, dataDir, intervalMs default 2000, debounceMs default 500, onSpawn?}): {stop()}. Poll every intervalMs: read git HEAD via git rev-parse HEAD and the working-tree signature via git status --porcelain, plus mtime of tracked files newer than the last generation; when the signature differs from the last observed one, wait debounceMs, re-check, then Bun.spawn bin/codegraph.ts worker and record the exit code. On exit 75 (lock held) log and retry on the next tick without counting a failure. On exit 1 increment an in-memory failure counter and back off to min(intervalMs << failures, 300000). Never writes the database itself and never imports the worker module. On stop(), kill a running child and resolve.
steps: Implement the poll loop reading git HEAD and porcelain status
Implement the debounce with a re-check before spawning
Implement Bun.spawn of the worker and exit-code handling including 75
Implement exponential backoff on failure and cleanup on stop
Write tests/watch.test.ts with a stubbed spawn covering change detection, debounce and lock retry
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/watch.test.ts. Done when a file change triggers exactly one spawn after the debounce window, an exit 75 does not increment the failure counter, and stop() resolves after killing a running child.

tasks.title: Freshness checks and health reporting on status

details.goal: Make staleness a computed, explained value rather than a boolean guess, and surface it on every status answer.
details.contract: freshness.ts exports checkFreshness(conn, repoRoot): {stale, stale_reason?, files_changed_since, checked_at} comparing each indexed file's sha256 against the current bytes and comparing meta project_root against the canonical repo root. stale_reason is one of files_changed, root_mismatch, base_commit_moved, watcher_stalled (indexer_state busy for more than 10 minutes) or none. Also export health(conn): {indexer, last_publish_ms, consecutive_failures, statement_cache_entries}. Update tools/status/handler.ts to include health.statement_cache_entries and to use the freshness module for read_status rather than reading meta directly. Keep the payload keys from TASK-020 unchanged except for the added health field.
steps: Write freshness.ts with the sha256 comparison and the four stale reasons
Add health() exposing statement cache size and failure counters
Wire status handler to freshness and health
Write tests/freshness.test.ts covering unchanged, changed, root mismatch and stalled watcher
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/freshness.test.ts && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/tools-status.test.ts. Done when the four stale reasons are each produced by their fixture and the status payload still has its documented keys plus health.statement_cache_entries.

tasks.title: Ship the instructions text that tells an agent how to use six tools

details.goal: Turn the measured adoption lever into a deliverable without inventing a fourth module layer.
details.contract: docs/INSTRUCTIONS.md is one screen and contains, in this order: a start-of-task rule (call summary with scope change), an area rule (summary scope area with target), a lookup rule (trace with one query), a blast-radius rule (impact before edits and before merge), a detail rule (expand next, never large budgets), and an anti-pattern list stating do not call index, do not treat total_relation gte as none, do not use trace to read source, and do not pass a project argument because the repo is bound at startup. It must also state the agent profile has exactly 6 tools and name them. src/shared/instructions.ts exports INSTRUCTIONS_TEXT (the same content as a string), printInstructions(): void writing to stdout only in an explicit CLI mode, and nextToolsFor(tool: string): string[] used by the composition root to populate next_tools. The module lives in shared, not in a new cli layer, so the three-layer layout in plan.constraint_invariant.md stays true. tests/instructions.test.ts asserts the text mentions all six tool names and the four anti-patterns, and that nextToolsFor returns a subset of the six names for all seven tools.
steps: Write app/docs/INSTRUCTIONS.md as the one-screen guide
Mirror it in src/shared/instructions.ts as INSTRUCTIONS_TEXT
Implement nextToolsFor with the routing table
Write tests/instructions.test.ts for names, anti-patterns and the subset rule
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/instructions.test.ts. Done when the text names all six tools and the four anti-patterns, and nextToolsFor returns only real tool names for all seven tools.

tasks.title: Packaging: README, compiled binary smoke check

details.goal: Prove the artifact builds, starts and answers a real tool call, and document distribution in the order the spec chose.
details.contract: README.md documents: install (bun, then bun install), first run (bun run index then bun run mcp), the seven tools with one line each, the .codegraph directory and its single-star .gitignore, the data-dir override and why it exists (read-only mounts and network filesystems), and distribution ORDER as stated in TECH-SPEC.md section 15: ship the npm package requiring Bun first, add the compiled binary once the grammar set is fixed, with measured sizes (compiled baseline about 104 MB plus grammars, Bun itself about 102 MB). tests/binary-smoke.test.ts must be a real test, not an initialize ping: build with bun build --compile into a temp dir, spawn the binary, complete initialize and notifications/initialized, then call tools/call status against a fixture data dir previously indexed by the worker, and assert the status payload reports the generation and the tool answered without loading any grammar-dependent path at startup. Assert zero non-JSON stdout lines. Skip with an explicit message if the compile exceeds 180 seconds.
steps: Write app/README.md with install, first run, tools table, distribution order and measured sizes
Write tests/binary-smoke.test.ts building the binary into a temp dir
Index a fixture through the worker, then call status over the spawned binary
Assert the generation is reported and no non-JSON stdout line appears
Add the 180 second timeout guard with an explicit skip reason
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/binary-smoke.test.ts. Done when the compiled binary answers a tools/call status request for an indexed fixture with the generation name and stdout contains no non-JSON line.

tasks.title: Phase 3 closing gate: acceptance criteria from DESIGN section 14

details.goal: Encode the product acceptance criteria plus the two unowned spikes as tests so regressions are caught by CI.
details.contract: acceptance.test.ts indexes the reference corpus code-review-graph/ into a temp data dir and asserts, in one file: (1) every tool response is within its declared default budget plus 10 percent, on real payloads; (2) total_relation eq appears only when coverage.complete is true and no unresolved rows exist in the queried scope, zero exceptions across at least 20 calls; (3) a request touching a not_indexed path returns coverage.complete false and lists the reason; (4) trace p95 under 40 ms, search p95 under 60 ms, summary change p95 under 120 ms over 30 repetitions each; (5) every response carries all nine required envelope fields, and error only when status is error or bootstrapping; (6) the seven tools are the only registered names and the agent profile exposes six; (7) spike S4 — a reader holding an open handle completes a query with unchanged results while a publish renames over the live file; (8) spike S6 — re-measuring the same 1 000 point reads built per call vs prepared must show the prepared path at least 5x faster, proving the no-builder-in-a-loop rule is load-bearing; (9) the statement cache stays at or below its 200-entry cap under 5 000 distinct query shapes. Failing threshold numbers must be printed so the report is actionable.
steps: Write the fixture indexing step reusing the worker
Implement the budget, coverage, envelope and profile sweeps
Implement the three latency measurements over 30 repetitions
Add the S4 concurrent-reader-during-publish assertion
Add the S6 builder-vs-prepared ratio and the statement-cache boundedness assertions
Record every measured number in the progress log
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/acceptance.test.ts. Done when all nine assertions pass, p95 values are under 40, 60 and 120 ms, the prepared path is at least 5x faster than the per-call builder, and the cache never exceeds 200 entries.
